info.title: AttendEase OS API
info.description: Official REST & Webhook API specification for AttendEase OS UHF RFID & Offline QR attendance appliance.

SessionAuth.name: attendease_session
SessionAuth.description: HttpOnly SameSite encrypted session cookie with CSRF double-submit token

ReaderBearerAuth.description: Cryptographically hashed bearer token provisioned per Zebra FX9600 reader

ReaderHmacAuth.name: X-Signature-SHA256
ReaderHmacAuth.description: HMAC-SHA256 over raw HTTP body using reader shared secret key

get.description: Returns status of database, redis cache, and background workers.

post.summary: Authenticate with phone number and password
Zebra FX9600 IoT Connector webhook ingest
post.description: High-throughput batched tag read ingest endpoint. Supports Bearer token or HMAC-SHA256 signature.

timestamp.description: Reader ISO timestamp or epoch millis

data.description: Array of tag reads (up to 250 items)

200.description: Batch processed successfully with per-read decision list

index.description: Original index position in incoming batch

decision.description: Ingest pipeline decision (e.g. ACCEPTED, DUPLICATE_DEBOUNCED, UNREGISTERED_CARD)

400.description: Malformed payload or oversized batch (>250 reads)

401.description: Reader authentication failed (invalid bearer token or HMAC signature)

post.summary: Enroll / issue new UHF EPC badge credential to student

patch.summary: Update badge credential status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, REVOKED, LOST)

post.summary: Register a new Zebra FX9600 reader

201.description: Reader registered with provisioned bearer token and HMAC secret

bearerToken.description: Cleartext token displayed ONCE at creation

hmacSecret.description: Cleartext HMAC secret displayed ONCE at creation

post.summary: Rotate reader authentication secrets (bearer token and HMAC key)
Create and enroll a new student record

patch.summary: Update student enrollment status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TRANSFERRED)

post.summary: Create attendance session for class section and date

201.description: Session created or existing session returned

patch.summary: Finalize attendance session and trigger absentee alerts

200.description: Session finalized, unmarked students marked absent, parent SMS queued
